label: When a download's name is already taken *Firefox never asks: it quietly saves the second copy as name(1).ext, and people find out weeks later that the file they wanted is the one without the number. Ask me puts a small window in front of the download instead: replace the file, keep both, or cancel. The other two answers skip the question and always do the same thing. Keep both is Firefox's own behaviour, so choosing it turns this mod off in everything but name.*

Only when downloads go straight to a folder *With 'Always ask you where to save files' turned on in Zen's own settings, every download opens the system save dialog, that dialog asks about replacing on its own, and this mod stays out of the way.*
